Title: TC-02.2 [AC-02.2] Case matching no category rule goes to General Intake

Step Action: Precondition check: Needs a Web API client (Category is only form-required).
Create a case with no Category through the Web API (Route Case = Yes).
Check the queues.
Step Expected: Case appears in General Intake (catch-all rule).

Title: TC-02.3 [AC-02.3] Re-categorized case moves to the new queue

Step Action: Route a case with Category Registration Issue.
Change Category to Facility Rental; Save & Route, then Route.
Open Registration & Payments queue items.
Step Expected: The case is no longer listed there.

Title: TC-02.4 [AC-02.4] Case created through the Web API routes on create

Step Action: Precondition check: Needs a Web API client.
POST a case with Category Complaint through the Web API (no explicit Route Case).
Check Supervisor Review(Public).
Step Expected: Case appears without any manual routing step.

Title: TC-02.5 [AC-02.5] Worked By is empty until a representative picks the item

Step Action: Route a case to Facility Rentals.
Step Expected: Queue item listed; Worked By is empty; case Owner unchanged.

Step Action: As Front Desk test user (user1), open the queue item and select Pick.
Step Expected: Worked By shows the Front Desk user.

Title: TC-02.6 [AC-02.6] Queue lists oldest cases first by Created On

Step Action: Route two cases to the same queue, the older one second (e.g., re-route an older case).
Open the queue's items view.
Step Expected: Items are ordered oldest first by the case's Created On.

Title: TC-02.7 [AC-02.1 (negative)] Plain Save doesn't route a form-created case

Step Action: Create a case with Category Complaint and select Save only.
Wait 2 minutes; check the timeline and Supervisor Review(Public).
Step Expected: No 'added to queue' post; case not in any queue.
